origine_fr: L'eau 氵 et 𠂢, un cours d'eau qui se divise, qui donnait aussi le son. Au début, 派 est un bras de rivière. Du bras qui quitte le fleuve viennent le groupe qui se détache, l'école, et « envoyer » quelqu'un en mission.
origine_en: Water 氵 and 𠂢, a stream splitting off, which also gave the sound. At first 派 was a branch of a river. From a branch leaving the river come the group that splits off, the school, and “to send” someone on a mission.

phrase.en: The company is sending him to Beijing.
